red.missingModule: The new workflow-scaffold test initially failed because the module did not exist.
red.checkerOnly: A source processor exiting 0 without writing the declared artifact is rejected as missing output.
red.pathHandoff: A processor writing a fixed observed path is rejected when the declared output path is absent.
red.partialInput: A multi-input run preserves an exit-2 not-applicable item while continuing independent inputs.

structures.singleInput: read one input -> invoke declared Node/Python processor with direct argv -> require declared output
structures.multiInput: process each input independently -> retain passed/not-applicable/failed items -> write workflow manifest
structures.sourceExecution: No source is read or executed while deriving candidates; materialized scaffolds invoke only the declared processor.
structures.contributions: Manifest separates framework files, source files, model files, step dependencies, and residual semantic duties.

workspaceIntegration.candidateBasis: observed execute operations with one explicit read, one write, an unambiguous entry, and direct argv bindings

claimBoundary: F6.1 supplies execution plumbing around an observed source processor; it is not a domain algorithm, real model-generated workflow, whole-skill correctness proof, cross-model result, readiness change, or prospective/held-out evidence.
